GOLD RUSH CONTRACT BRIEFING
Contract the-claim at trail difficulty. Hold the claim through the posted secure wave; survive and the win is banked. Strategy that works: HOLD near your claim, BUILD a sluice beside water and turrets/palisades on the pressed edges early, HARVEST seams between waves, set REPAIR_UNDER and a FALLBACK_IF. Return one JSON array of standing orders, with no prose.
